title: Cylindrical rod
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Within this face, draw a single loop and within this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.0118, 0.0118) with a radius of 0.0118 meters. After drawing the circle, apply a scaling factor of 0.0235 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using Euler angles of zero degrees and translate it using a translation vector of zero. Finally, extrude the scaled and transformed two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by a depth of 0.75 meters to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical rod will be a length and width of 0.0235 meters and a height of 0.75 meters.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the cylindrical section
cylinder = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0118, 0.0118)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0118)         # Create a circle with the given radius
    .extrude(0.75)          # Extrude the circle to create the cylindrical section
)

# Create the rectangular section
rectangle = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0118, 0.0118)  # Move to the center of the rectangle
    .rect(0.0235, 0.0235)    # Create a rectangle with the given dimensions
    .extrude(0.75)          # Extrude the rectangle to create the rectangular section
)

# Combine the cylindrical and rectangular sections
r = cylinder.union(rectangle)

# Display the final model

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# Octagonal prism: regular octagon cross-section, extruded along Z.
# Bounding box: X 0.0236, Y 0.0236, Z 0.7500.
# For a regular octagon the bounding box is square, with side equal to the
# width across flats = d * cos(pi/8), where d is the circumscribed diameter.

bbox = 0.0236
d = bbox / math.cos(math.pi / 8)  # circumscribed circle diameter

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polygon(8, d)
    .extrude(0.75)
)

import cadquery as cq

# The part is a long square bar:
# cross-section 0.0236 x 0.0236 (X by Y) and length 0.7500 along Z.
# Front, right and top views all confirm a plain square prism with no
# holes, slots or other features.

size = 0.0236
length = 0.75

# Sketch the square cross-section on the XY plane (bottom face) and extrude
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(size, size)
    .extrude(length)
)
